entries.source: This strange creature seems to melt around your neck, keeping its mouth open just wide enough so that its teeth do not touch you. You suspect that in the case your head somehow goes missing, the creature is going to make itself at home in your neck stump.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的生物仿佛融化般裹住你的脖子，把嘴张到牙齿刚好不会碰到你的程度。你怀疑，如果你哪天掉了脑袋，这个生物就会在你脖子的断口处安家落户。
